# Farhan Abel Rantisi — Mobile Developer & UI/UX Designer

> Crafting premium mobile and web experiences with Flutter, Kotlin, React, and TypeScript.

## Profile Summary
Farhan Abel Rantisi is an experienced Mobile Developer and UI/UX Designer based in Indonesia. He specializes in cross-platform mobile development (Flutter, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Dart) and modern web applications (React, TypeScript, Vite, Node.js).

## Key Skills & Technologies
- **Mobile Development**: Flutter, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Dart, Swift, REST API, Firebase
- **Web & Frontend**: React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI
- **Database & Cloud**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, Git, CI/CD
- **Design**: Figma, UI/UX Design, Prototyping
